items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: I didn't have much interest in Jelly Roll Morton then. I didn't appreciate him. I didn't know what he was really doing.

ctx.x: Was he dull? Do you remember him at all?

No, I don't. Actually, I remember him sitting there and playing. Uh, I don't remember at first that he was especially audible. Yeah. That's one thing in that context. And another thing, uh, uh, I wasn't predisposed to pay close attention to him at the time, because I didn't have much interest in Jelly Roll Morton then. I didn't appreciate him. I didn't know what he was really doing. Uh, what he was playing was by that time substantially removed from what I thought of as authentic jazz. And, uh, that, as I realize…
As compared with the, uh, uh, jungle?
